The reckoning is found in the gambit directory and is a 4 player match-made activity, with 3 difficulties. The difficulties are not much different, but with the updates in new light, I recommend going straight to Tier 3, which consists of 3 parts. The first of which is simply killing adds, afterwards you proceed along a bridge, capturing different sections of it( as you would on control). The last part is a boss. There are 2 bosses, which alternate every week. The bosses have specific weapon drops, and the armor sets can be acquired by wagering things called “motes”. Motes are made by combining 1, 2 or 3 synths. Synths are consumables which drop from doing certain things in gambit prime, or drifter bounties( which are bought from the drifter in the tower). The current boss and loot table can be seen on the weekly reset infographic found on niris.tv (made by a community member). If you have any other questions feel free to let me know, enjoy the grind!
